scope: Editorial review of the current 72 systematic lessons backed by 37 formal political knowledge units; not a complete political theory or exam curriculum.

policy.systematicTask: Explain how a bounded group of knowledge answers one question, including necessary links and boundaries.
policy.recallTask: Recover a key statement or boundary without replacing systematic explanation.
policy.confusionTask: Discriminate two nearby targets on one dimension without replacing either lesson.
policy.sourceBoundary: Source gaps are narrowed explicitly; no missing theory, current affairs, or mechanism is generated.
policy.runtimeBoundary: The curriculum remains candidate-only and draft at runtime even though B4 editorial review is complete.
